dct_title_s: Philippines Earthquake Mindanao: Damage Proxy Maps, Jun 2026
dct_description_sm: # Philippines Earthquake Mindanao: Damage Proxy Maps, Jun 2026 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Philippines Earthquake Mindanao (Jun 2026) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Mindanao, Philippines, Earthquakes, 16 June 2026, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Mindanao, Philippines, Earthquakes, 13 June 2026, v0.5 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: West Mindanao, Philippines, Earthquakes, 09 June 2026, v0.8 ** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026)
